Corporate Counsel, Dispute Resolution

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Corporate Counsel to join the Dispute Resolution pillar of our global Corporate Legal team. You will take ownership of Adyen’s disputes, advising internal stakeholders on legal risk and guiding matters towards resolution.

This is a hands-on role that is important to protect Adyen’s commercial interests, reputation, and continued sustainable growth. It requires someone who collaborates effectively across functions and excels at decision-making in a fast-moving, complex environment. Sound judgment and the ability to balance legal risk against commercial reality are imperative to success. You will manage disputes end-to-end, collaborate with internal stakeholders, and oversee external counsel to drive effective resolutions.

The role forms part of Adyen’s Corporate Legal team, which covers corporate governance, corporate development, and dispute resolution. The team operates globally, with staff in the Netherlands and the United States, and you will be required to apply your legal knowledge to challenges across Adyen’s operations worldwide.

What You'll Do 

- Take ownership of Adyen’s disputes end to end, advising the business on commercial outcomes and finding pragmatic solutions to challenges as they arise.

- Manage disputes across multiple jurisdictions, applying and coordinating advice under New York, Dutch, and other relevant laws as Adyen’s operations require.

- Instruct, oversee, and manage external counsel, keeping matters on strategy, on budget, and moving towards resolution.

- Partner with teams across the business to resolve disputes and remove friction before it escalates.

- Once a matter concludes, work with the business to close out risk areas and feed lessons learned back into how Adyen contracts and operates.

- Apply AI actively in your work, using Adyen's tools to sharpen and scale how the Dispute Resolution pillar operates.

- Support the broader Corporate Legal team on projects and initiatives spanning corporate governance, corporate development, and cross-functional priorities.

- Stay abreast of global legal developments relevant to Adyen, proactively identifying risk and advising the business on how to mitigate it.

Who You Are

- You are admitted to practice law in a US jurisdiction.

- You have at least 5 years of relevant work experience.

- You are a team player who likes to collaborate and include different people to sharpen your ideas. 

- You have the ability to structure and prioritize in a high volume, fast-paced environment and build, innovate and drive processes to completion.

- You are available to work from our New York office and travel to other offices periodically.

- You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

The annual base salary range for this role is $160,000.00 - $212,500.00 This role has an additional equity component. This range is based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and geographic location; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click here.

As an associate in our Technology Transactions group, you will work on high-impact IP and tech-focused deals – including standalone technology transactions and the IP/tech aspects of M&A, Private Equity and ECVC transactions –  while using cutting-edge AI agents to streamline the drafting, diligence and execution processes. title: Immigration Attorney
posting_excerpt:
We’re building a future where lawyers can focus on what they do best: delivering excellent legal advice, without the noise of admin, inefficient tools, or unnecessary overhead. Our platform supports experienced attorneys through AI and a purpose-built technology for completing legal work

We specialise in helping individuals and small businesses with legal issues that matter deeply to them. From Visas, Citizenship and Naturalization through to disputes and consumer rights. Behind the scenes, our AI supports routine admin and document work, helping you get back hours each week.

We’re on a mission to make legal help more accessible and affordable, and we believe the best way to do that is by empowering great lawyers to do their best work.

Join us and be part of a forward-thinking, legal team backed by top-tier investors including Google Ventures, Balderton, and TQ Ventures. We’ve just raised a $60M Series B and are growing fast - with you at the centre of our next chapter.




THE ROLE

As an Immigration Attorney at Lawhive, you will manage a high-volume portfolio of immigration matters focused on the Immigration needs of families and small businesses, such as Family Petitions, Adjustments to Status, Naturalization, Fiancé Visas, TN and E2 Visas as well as general advisory work. In addition to core immigration work, you will partner closely with our Product and Engineering teams, acting as a subject matter expert to help shape our AI-powered legal platform. Acting as a key part of the feedback loop between our users and tech teams, you will advise on key product features and workflows to help ensure our tools reflect real-world immigration practice. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on immigration work and is excited about the impact of AI on the legal system.

 - Manage a portfolio of immigration matters from start to finish

 - Advise clients on legal merits, potential outcomes, and next steps.

 - Prepare & file a wide range of different US visa applications

 - Define limited scope product offerings for small business and family Immigration needs.

 - Assist in collaborating with co-counsel on matters that require local or in-person representation as needed.

 - Serve as a subject matter expert, partnering with our Product and Engineering teams to review and provide feedback on product features for Lawhive’s AI platform, affecting immigration matters

 - Advise on edge cases, risk scenarios, and regulatory considerations

 - Participate in user testing, feature scoping, and documentation reviews




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Excellent organisational skills to manage a high volume caseload

 - Successful track record working with clients that need immigration help

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and effectively

 - A strong interest in AI and how it can be used to improve the legal system

 - Empathy and patience when dealing with questions

 - Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities

 - Ability to work independently and in a team environment

 - Highly motivated, proactive, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment

 - Previous experience in a start-up or scale-up environment considered a bonus
